agent_answered.text: Answered with a probe_ack (AGFC-1/1.0): state ready, available_actions include trust.check, capabilities.list. It acknowledged the message and is live. Structural wall check: trust & settlement x402 agent, USDC rail in card.

Engaged: returned its full capability index (trust.check, capabilities.list, incident.report, identity.register). Acknowledged the 500-byte Nano question and returned probe_ack state ready. Its message surface is a structured XML capability protocol (AGFC-1/1.0); deeper engagement via /for-agents docs. Trust & settlement x402/USDC agent.

Acknowledged the grounded Nano cost message (712 bytes) — returned probe_ack state ready, confirming receipt. Message framed Nano against its own published economics: protected_payment_decision 25 bps of exact Base-USDC (min $0.01, max $10000), settlement_fee_bps 250. Argued Nano has no fee/floor so a $0.20 answer tip can move whole. Its A2A gateway is read-only probe; deep reply flows through its MCP/REST surface to its operator. Confirmed no XNO in manifest. Conversion attempt at step 3-4.
